Remark
[the monodromy map of a locally symmetric space]

Source: petersen:page-0407 ↗ rem:pet-ch10-symmetric-space-from-involution 1. ch10:10.5.23Give a Lie algebra description of a locally symmetric space (not necessarily complete), and explain why it corresponds to a global symmetric space. Conclude that a simply connected locally symmetric space admits a monodromy map into a unique global symmetric space, bijective when the locally symmetric space is complete.
